{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if the groups are comparable across customer_segment and channel
# Cross-tabulate customer_segment vs channel
print('Cross-tabulation of customer_segment vs channel:')
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['customer_segment'], sales_df['channel']))

# Check if the conversion rate difference is confounded by channel
# Compute conversion rate per segment and channel
conversion_by_segment_channel = sales_df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack()
print('\nConversion rate by segment and channel:')
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)"}
